title: NordvikManager card template or view
description: A file in an addon's Templates/ or Views/ folder. Templates are copied into cards; views open as panels. See https://nordvikmanager.pl/addon-guide/cards/overview

permission.description: Permission flags, added together: None=0, Read=1, Execute=2, Control=4, Edit=8, Remove=16, All=31.

name.title: Name
name.description: Shown in the app; also how actions find the card by name.

key.title: Key
key.description: Short identifier of the template or view within the addon.

mainResource.title: Main resource
mainResource.description: The card's HTML page, as a resource key: '<addon key>_<file name>' for a file in Resources/, e.g. 'myaddon_index.html'.

additionalResources.title: Additional resources
additionalResources.description: Resource keys added to the page in order: .css files into <head>, .js files at the end of <body>. Other file types are not added; read them with CardAPI.Resources.

hidden.title: Hidden
hidden.description: Keeps a template out of the GM's and players' template lists. It can still be used by id or by name, e.g. from an action.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: Player id of the owner. Usually left out.

genericPermission.title: Everyone's permission
genericPermission.description: What every player may do with cards made from this template. Permission flags: None=0, Read=1, Execute=2, Control=4, Edit=8, Remove=16, All=31.

gmPermission.title: GM's permission
gmPermission.description: What the GM may do. Permission flags: None=0, Read=1, Execute=2, Control=4, Edit=8, Remove=16, All=31.

properties.title: Properties
properties.description: The card's data. Every card made from the template starts with a copy.

value.description: Always a string: write "10", not 10. Use JSON text for structured values.

isProtected.description: Players without Edit can't read the value.
